card.name: Casual words in informal tech prose
card.fires_on: Casual, conversational words in informal web text, often technical forum or blog writing. Typical hits are 'unhappy', 'interesting', 'stuff', 'you' and 'want'.

modes.label: Casual adjectives and nouns
modes.description: Informal evaluative words such as unhappy, interesting or stuff, often after an intensifier like very or wild.
modes.example: all sorts of wild<< stuff>> can happen

modes.label: Chatty clause words in a BSD forum post
modes.description: Small words in a conversational explanation of a disk label, such as you, want, comma or see.
modes.example: is what you want, and<< you>> can see it's a msdos filesystem

card.plain: It marks relaxed, chatty wording in informal technical or travel writing, not label language.
